profile.headline: PHP Developer  at The Transformation Group
profile.summary:
Qualified, strong team player with over 10 years of development experience in PHP, VB.NET and C++. Passionate about web and application development. Has worked as team lead with developers and business stakeholders from project start to completion. The ideal candidate that is proficient in mobile technologies. Able to create re-usable web applications using PHP, ASP.net, VBScript, and JavaScript. Proficient in extracting dynamic data with scripting.

Has a passion to learn new technologies and skills that will complement and enhance current skill set. Can pick up a new language quickly by reading or using online tutorials.

Web Development, Systems Analyst, Front-end/Back-end Engineer, C#/C++, Vb.net, MySQL, Javascript, HTML5, WordPress, CSS, Photoshop, Jira, Git, PHP, Mobile Game Dev (IOS and Android), Unity, Xcode, Salesforce, Database Management (SQL/PostGre), Informatica, AWS Cloud, ReactJS, Node.js

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
* Develop custom WordPress templates, landing pages, and components using PHP, Tailwind, HTML, and JavaScript.
* Build ACF-driven admin interfaces that reduce content editing time for non-technical users.
* Create custom post types and taxonomies to support scalable site features.
* Convert Figma designs into responsive, mobile-first pages aligned with brand standards.
* Optimize content for SEO, improving visibility and organic search performance.
* Manage Git-based deployments and CLI-driven package installation (Composer, NPM, Yarn).
* Improved SEO ranking for FAQ pages, increasing organic traffic by 20%.

positions.title: UKG Integrations Developer
positions.description:
* Designed and maintained UKG Pro integrations using REST APIs and SQL, improving cross‑system data accuracy and reliability.
* Automated onboarding, job changes, and termination workflows, reducing manual HR intervention and data discrepancies.
* Optimized API utilization and transformation logic, reducing processing time for recurring sync jobs.
* Performed root-cause analysis for complex data issues across UKG Pro and SQL databases.
* Collaborated with HRIS, Payroll, IT, and vendor teams to deliver scalable integration solutions supporting enterprise operations.

positions.title: Business Analyst/Project Manager
positions.description:
* Managed fundraising technology launches generating $1M+ revenue across multiple chapters.
* Led requirements gathering, design, development, QA, and go-live for high-visibility digital initiatives.
* Coordinated with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and offshore developers to ensure timely delivery.

positions.title: Sr. Systems Analyst, Cloud Technology
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
* Managed SQL/PostgreSQL databases and cloud data workflows using Informatica, reducing manual reporting time.
* Supported Salesforce NPSP implementation and integrations across enterprise systems.
* Delivered WordPress multisite features supporting 70+ chapters and 200k+ monthly users.
* Developed QA test cases, executed testing procedures, and maintained overall system health and performance.
* Utilized AWS to support Redshift/Informatica data pipelines and troubleshoot AWS‑hosted application ecosystems, contributing to smoother data operations and system behavior.
* Built ASP.NET SSO solutions and custom intranet applications to streamline access and internal workflows.
* Launched 100+ fundraising sites annually with custom WordPress themes and CMS enhancements.
* Integrated Salesforce with WordPress forms and analytics to improve data capture and reporting accuracy.
* Oversaw Google Analytics reporting and SEO/SEM initiatives to optimize digital engagement.

projects.title: Word Tourney
projects.description: Word Tourney is a soon to be released mobile game.  Created using Unity/C# on the platform side and using PHP/MySQL on the server side.
